17 + 25

7 + 5 = 12

Write a paragraph of about 120 words explaining what version control is for.

reply.text: Version control is a system that tracks changes to files and documents over time, allowing multiple users to work on the same project simultaneously without conflicts. It helps in maintaining a history of all modifications made to the code or content, enabling developers to revert back to previous versions if necessary. This ensures that every change can be reviewed and understood, facilitating collaboration and improving software development efficiency.
